verdict.rationale: Snyk is a SaaS security platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an interactive API reference or runnable API examples. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path, and the llms.txt, CLI and MCP evidence covers different capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
